name: SalesOrderItem
description: A tea lot and its ordered quantity, agreed rate, and line amount within a Sales Order.

fields.label: Tea Lot
fields.description: Eligible lot selected from the chosen warehouse.

fields.label: Final Grade
fields.description: Final grade fetched from the confirmed tea valuation.

fields.label: Available Bags
fields.description: Current unreserved bags available for selection. Revalidate on the server when confirming.

fields.label: Ordered Bags
fields.description: Number of bags requested from this lot.

fields.label: Net KG per Bag
fields.description: Net weight per bag fetched from lot registration.

fields.label: Total Weight (KG)
fields.description: Calculated as ordered bags multiplied by net kilograms per bag.

fields.label: Agreed Rate per KG
fields.description: Rate agreed for this lot, subject to the applicable party rules.

fields.label: Line Amount
fields.description: Calculated as total weight multiplied by the agreed rate per kilogram.
